Package gov.nyc.doitt.gis.geoclient.jni

Interface Geoclient

All Known Implementing Classes:
GeoclientJni
public interface Geoclient
Defines Geoclient's public Java API for interacting with JNI and native C code linked to Geosupport native libraries. The code in this class was originally generated by the gluegen framework but that proved unnecessary when using Geosupport's work area C/C++ API. This is because the overall work area sizes remain constant and field changes by DCP can be adjusted using positional mappings (i.e., geoclient-core's geoclient.xml file).
